results.title: Keeping prompts across brands, categories and markets only decreases the shared pool

steps.expected: The pool block reads "U / P"

steps.title: When the user starts a new analysis for a brand that no analysis of the organisation uses yet
steps.data: Brand: a brand not used yet in T (e.g. "Decathlon")
steps.expected: Brand & Country accepts the brand with no brand quota message

steps.title: And the user adds 4 markets including one country in two languages
steps.data: United Kingdom - English (EN), France - French (FR), United States - English (EN), United States - Spanish (ES)
steps.expected: The 4 market rows are added with no country, language or market limit message

steps.title: And the user keeps every detected category and adds categories until there are at least 6
steps.expected: Every category is added with no category limit message

steps.title: And the user opens the Prompts step
steps.expected: The toolbar ring reads "U + S / P", S being the number of ticked prompts of this analysis

steps.title: Then no per-brand, per-category, per-country or per-language cap blocks the selection
steps.expected: The only limit shown is the pool ring; Review & Launch is enabled while U + S <= P

results.notes: Org QA-GEO, P = 1000. Dashboard pool block read "530 / 1000" at start. Brand Decathlon (decathlon.com) accepted with no brand quota message; 4 markets UK EN, France FR, US EN, US ES added with no limit message; 2 detected categories (Sports Equipment, Athletic Apparel) + Running Shoes, Cycling, Camping, Hiking = 6, no category limit message (only banner "Categories are unlimited and set by you"). Prompts step: ring "1250 / 1000 · 760 selected", popover "In use by other analyses 490 / Kept in this analysis 760 / Over the pool 250", Review & Launch disabled. U had moved from 530 to 490 during the run: the Volkswagen analysis (40 slots) was removed from QA-GEO by someone else between the dashboard read and the Prompts step (/quota then returned promptsUsed 490), so the ring matches U + S / P for the current U. After unticking all and re-ticking 100: ring "590 / 1000 · 100 selected", no pool message, Review & Launch enabled. Only limit shown = pool ring. Precondition deviation: unbranded flag is ON (wizard has an Analysis Type step); "Brand analysis" was selected to reach Brand & Country. Nothing was created.

Create organisation form: Name *, Master Customer Number, US organisation, QUOTAS: "Prompt pool *" (same "*" marker as "Name *"), User quota (100), Collection frequency (Daily / One time), Authorised AI Engine providers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Perplexity). No per-type prompt field, no "Countries" field, no "Categories max" field. Form closed with Cancel, nothing saved. Known bug GEO-1274 (missing asterisk) did NOT reproduce: the asterisk is now shown.

results.error: Expected: New Analysis opens the wizard directly on Brand & Country, sidebar stepper "Brand & Country", "Categories", "Prompts", "Review" with Brand & Country current, footer "Back" and "Discover Categories". Observed: the wizard opens on step 1 "Analysis Type" (Brand analysis / Unbranded analysis), stepper shows 5 steps "Analysis Type", "Brand & Country", "Categories", "Prompts", "Review" with Analysis Type current, and the footer shows "Back" and "Continue". results.notes: Analysis CREATED for this TC: Decathlon (decathlon.com), UUID a054db66-6f22-45e0-8256-13c1bd56464b, org QA-GEO, market United Kingdom English, category C1 = Sporting Goods, 30 prompts kept (10 Visibility unticked, 10 Competitive + 10 Reputation + 10 Brand Image kept), engines ChatGPT + Gemini. Wizard showed no competitor step; no network request with "competitor" in the URL during generation; Review showed "Some metrics will not be produced. No Visibility prompts are kept...". Created at 18:17:40Z, status COMPLETED at 18:17:43Z (first collection finished in about 3 s, unusually fast). Category page Prompts Analysis: Visibility 0, Competitive 10, Perception 10; Competitive prompts name Sports Direct, JD Sports, Go Outdoors (Winner Split / Lost). No Decathlon sub-brand (Quechua, Btwin, Kipsta, Domyos, Kalenji, Forclaz, Rockrider, Kiprun...) found on the page. Brand ownership of the competitor websites was checked by name only. The analysis is left in QA-GEO (no delete in this run).
